svg.title: Two webhook endpoints in one function app: Dataverse calls Cedar, and FieldLink calls Cedar
svg.desc: The function app func-cedar-fieldlink-dev has two HTTP endpoints with the same shape: authenticate, bound the size, validate, put a small message on a queue, answer at once. Top row, outbound, decision IN-02 first increment: Dataverse posts the execution context of an asynchronous step on Update of a work order to the function WorkOrderChanged; the caller is authenticated by the function key that Dataverse appends as the code query parameter, and by the organization header; the pure class ChangeNotices turns the context into a contract message, cedar.workorder.rescheduled.v1 or cedar.workorder.cancelled.v1, or into nothing; the message goes to the storage queue fieldlink-outbound and the answer is 202, or 204 when nothing needs to be sent, 400 for a body that is not a context, 403 for another organization. Delivery to FieldLink from that queue is built in lessons 91 and 95. Bottom row, inbound, decision IN-03, component C-13: FieldLink posts a status or arrival event to the function FieldLinkEvents; the caller is authenticated by an HMAC SHA-256 signature over timestamp and body with a shared secret from Key Vault, and requests older than five minutes are refused; the message is validated against the contract; the answer is 202 accepted, 401 for a bad signature, 422 for a message outside the contract, 400 for malformed JSON, 413 or 415 for size or content type. The accepted event goes to the queue fieldlink-inbound, and the queue-triggered worker ApplyFieldLinkEvent applies it to Dataverse as the application user FieldLink Sync Functions: a status through the forward-only bulk writer of lesson 78, an arrival through the business event cedar_OnSubcontractorArrived of lesson 71. Failures are retried five times, a minute apart, then rest in the poison queue.
svg.text: Same shape twice: authenticate → bound → validate → queue → answer. Nobody waits for the work.
Outbound (IN-02, first increment): Dataverse tells Cedar's function that a sent work order changed
Inbound (IN-03, C-13): FieldLink tells Cedar that a job moved
Dataverse → Cedar: a key that Dataverse stores and appends (WebhookKey). Cedar also checks which
environment is calling. The key is a secret of the function app; rotate it by re-registering the endpoint.
FieldLink → Cedar: a signature made with a shared secret. It proves the sender AND that the body was not
changed, and the signed timestamp limits replay. The secret lives in Key Vault on Cedar's side.
Both: accepted (202) is not processed. Duplicates are harmless: the id is stable, the write is idempotent.
